name: Vishnu Vishal
bio: Vishnu Vishal (born 17 July 1984) is an Indian film actor who has appeared in Tamil language films.  After a brief career in cricket, he started his acting career in the year 2009 playing the lead role in the sports film Vennila Kabadi Kuzhu, winning acclaim for his portrayal. Vishnu won further acclaim for his role in Neerparavai (2012), portraying a fisherman. He rose to fame with the psychological thriller film, Ratsasan (2018).
